quarterly_data.signal: Wistron subsidiary SMS Infocomm Corporation (WTX) will lease a plant in Texas, USA of 231,754 square feet from Caribou 351 Lakeside Parkway, LLC for a term of 7 years 2 months (total rent about US$18,188 thousand; right-of-use asset US$15,051 thousand), board-approved 2026-09-09 for business operation needs; it replaces the plant lease from GTIS HIGHWAY 121 SPE LP approved on 2025-05-06, which was cancelled.
